disks.title: The disks
disks.intro: A disk is added with one volume line on the kernel, in the installation's compose file: “<path>:/mnt/<name>”. It is laid out like the server's folder: games, BIOS, cores, settings and patches (roms/<console>/…, bios/<console>/…). Its games play here, with the folder's cores and BIOS; the rest is imported from its own screen (Cores, BIOS…). Your friends see the folder and the disks as one.
disks.introDevice: A disk is added from the app's home screen (Internal disks › Add a disk): a hard drive plugged over USB, an SD card. It is laid out like the library: games, BIOS, cores, settings and patches (roms/<console>/…, bios/<console>/…). Its games play here, with the library's cores and BIOS; the rest is imported from its own screen (Cores, BIOS…). Your friends see the library and the disks as one.
disks.absent: Missing: nothing to read (disk unplugged, or not mounted when the stack started)
disks.absentDevice: Missing: nothing to read (disk unplugged, or a folder without roms, bios, cores, params or patches)
disks.empty: No internal disk: add a volume “<path>:/mnt/<name>” to the kernel in the compose file.
disks.emptyDevice: No internal disk: add one from the app's home screen (Internal disks › Add a disk).

register.discoverResultsLabel: Found on the network — click to fill in
register.identifierHint: Your PSN account ID, Base64-encoded 8-byte data (not your PSN username).
register.pinHelp: Shown on the console: Settings > Remote Play > Add Device
register.pinInvalid: The PIN code must be numeric

device.detailsHelp: What this app knows about the console.
device.sourceHelp: Where the consoles shown come from. Yours are here; a federated server lends you its own, and you still sign in over there to use one.

settings.title: Stream settings
settings.help: Resolution, frame rate and bitrate for this session's video stream.
settings.resolutionHelp: A higher resolution gives a sharper picture and needs more bandwidth. Lower it first when the stream stutters.
settings.frameRateHelp: More frames per second feel smoother; fewer leave bandwidth for a sharper picture.
settings.bitrateHelp: "Auto" lets the encoder choose. A PlayStation adapts it live; for the other consoles, the page moves to a 540p stream when the network weakens.
settings.probeUnreachable: Network unreachable, couldn't suggest a setting.

federation.playingAtHelp: You play there as your account "{{name}}" at {{server}}.
federation.tokenHelp: It plays at {{server}}, under your account over there. Paste that account's invitation or its token — once, and you're set.
federation.tokenRefusedHelp: {{server}} refuses the token you pasted: it was disabled, it expired or it was regenerated. Paste the new one.
federation.tokenWhere: In Settings › Profile, at {{server}} — an administrator over there must have enabled it.

retrogaming.gpuAvailable: This phone has an Adreno GPU: this console's emulator renders on it.
retrogaming.gamesDescription: The game library for this console. Pick one to play, or open it for details, cores and BIOS options.
retrogaming.experimentalWarning: Still experimental: this emulator can crash mid-game, and some titles never start at all.
retrogaming.experimentalHeavyWarning: Still experimental for the most demanding games: a few heavy titles can crash or run at half speed. The rest play fine.
retrogaming.experimentalFirmwareWarning: Still experimental: some games need a different system firmware than the one installed, and won't start without it.
retrogaming.noGpuWarning: No usable GPU on this device: this console's emulator would run on the processor alone, far too slow to play. Play these games on a federated server — retro consoles work fine here.
retrogaming.noGames: No games found for this console.
retrogaming.noCoreConfigured: No emulator core is configured for this console.

detail.downloadInBrowser: The download opens in your browser.

noLaunch.server-offline: That source is not answering — a server that is off, or a share unplugged.
noLaunch.remote-launch-refused: Your account on that server does not launch this console. You can:
noLaunch.owner-only: On this device, only an administrator starts a game. Join the one in progress from the dashboard.
noLaunch.not-in-library: This game is not in the library here. Add it from Settings › Games, or play it on its own server.
noLaunch.also-in-library: This game is also in your library: pick the “On this device” source to play it here.
noLaunch.game-missing: That target does not have this game.
noLaunch.core-missing: The chosen emulator core is not installed.
noLaunch.bios-missing: The BIOS this console needs is missing.
noLaunch.console-not-granted: Your account does not launch this console. You can still browse and download its games; an administrator sets your consoles in Settings › Members.
noLaunch.federation-refused: That server revoked our link: its games can no longer be read from here. An administrator here adds it again with a new token (Settings › Federations).
noLaunch.unauthorised: First paste the token of your account on that server, just below: the game will start from there.
noLaunch.account-refused: That server refuses your token: it was disabled, it expired or it was regenerated. Copy it again from Settings › Profile, over there, and paste it below.

remote-launch-refused: ask its administrator to add this console to your account (Settings › Members, over there);
ask an administrator here to add the game to the library (Settings › Games).

detail.removeHelp: Deletes the file from this device to free up space. The game stays available on its own server.
detail.removeConfirm: Delete this game from the device? You will have to download it again to play offline.
detail.emulatorHelp: The core that will run this game. Some need a BIOS.
detail.biosHelp2: Which BIOS to use. Most consoles ask for none.

origin.titleHelp: Where this game is stored: on this device, or on a server you are connected to.
origin.title: Source

streaming.cheatCodeHelp: The code as published for this game (Game Genie, Action Replay, GameShark…).
streaming.cheatNameHelp: A name to find this code again in your list.
streaming.stateRefused: The installed core ({{core}}) cannot read this save: it was probably made by another version of this core. Make a new one.
streaming.stateRefusedOther: This save was made by {{stateCore}}; the installed core ({{core}}) cannot read it. Make a new one with this core.
streaming.cheatListHelp: Toggle a cheat on or off, or edit/delete it. Saved to your account for this game.
streaming.cheatListEmpty: No cheats added yet — add one above.
streaming.deleteStateConfirm: Delete the save in this slot?

retrogaming.filterSourceHelp: The library here, one of its internal disks, or the games of a federated server.
retrogaming.peerDenied: This federated server does not allow access to its consoles. Please ask its owners for access.
retrogaming.peerOffline: This federated server is not answering: its games cannot be listed right now.
retrogaming.gameGone: That game is no longer in this console's library.
retrogaming.hostResources: {{host}}: {{resources}}. This console's emulator renders on that GPU.
retrogaming.hostNoGpu: {{host}} has no usable GPU ({{resources}}): this console's emulator would run on the CPU alone, far too slow to play.

settings.passwordHelp: Change your password and security settings
settings.appHelp: Application preferences: language, theme, and the rest
settings.padsSectionHelp: Change your controller and device settings
settings.adminTitle: With great power comes great responsibility
settings.adminHelp: Advanced settings: members, storage and federation
settings.remoteHelp: A Samba share, a WebDAV folder or a kDrive — their games join your catalogue.
settings.downloadHelp: Download the GameFlex app for Android (v{{version}})
settings.orientationHelpApp: For the whole application, its home screen included.
settings.orientationHelpBrowser: During a game: the browser can only turn the game, in fullscreen.
settings.orientationPortraitHalfHelp: For a controller that clips onto the bottom of the phone: as soon as a controller is connected, the interface moves to the top half of the screen. If nothing changes, press a button on the controller.
settings.halfScreenHeightHelp: How much of the screen the interface keeps above the controller. Adjust it until the bottom of the interface meets the controller.
settings.appHomeTitle: Back to the app's home screen
settings.appHomeHelp: Closes this interface and brings back the app's home screen. You stay signed in.
settings.appHomeFailed: The app didn't go back to its home screen
settings.federationsHelp: The GameFlex servers you registered, and the tokens you issued for others.
settings.internalHelp: This machine's other disks — their games play here, with the library's consoles; their cores, BIOS, settings and patches can be imported.

keytest.controllerHelp: Try another one without leaving — the session stays up.
keytest.exitConfirm: Leaving ends this test session. Nobody else is on it.

download.installFromPhone: Open this page from the phone, then download.
download.installAllow: Android will ask you to allow installing from this source — that is normal for an app that does not come from the Play Store.
download.whatConnected: It connects to this server: your sessions, the stream, the on-screen pad and link sharing, just like in the browser — but with an icon on your home screen, real fullscreen, and a screen that does not go dark mid-game. Physical controllers work here too.
download.whatAlone: It also plays on its own. The device has its own library — its games, firmwares and emulators — which the admin fills from the settings. Once there, they play with no network and no server.

gameStatus.title: Status
gameStatus.help: Whether this game plays on this server. The emulator versions are noted in the history.
gameStatus.detailHelp: As an administrator of this game's server found it, on its machine.
gameStatus.emulatorsHelp: The ones this status applies to. All of them by default.
gameStatus.noteHelp: Optional: what happens, and where ("crashes in chapter 2").
gameStatus.failed: The status could not be saved.
gameStatus.consoleHelp: Every game of the console without a status of its own takes this one, games added later included.
gameStatus.consoleOpenHelp: Set the status of every game of a console at once.
gameStatus.consoleNone: Now: {{status}}, the default for this console.
gameStatus.consoleSaved: {{console}}: every game without a status of its own is now "{{status}}".
gameStatus.filterHelp: Show only the games with these statuses.

invitations.tokenInstead: Rather the link and the token
invitations.revealHelp: Send it by any messaging app: they scan the QR or paste the link into their GameFlex, and their server fetches the token from this one. The token itself never travels.
invitations.validUntil: Valid until {{at}} (12 hours), and only once. After that, create another one.
invitations.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available here: copy the link instead.
invitations.serverFieldHelp: The link they sent you, or read from their QR. Your server fetches the token from theirs: valid 12 hours, only once.
invitations.accountFieldHelp: Created at {{server}} in Settings › Profile, “My QR”. Your server fetches your token from {{server}}: valid 12 hours, only once.
invitations.nameHelp: Optional: the name it shows under on your side. By default, the name it gives itself.
invitations.imageLabel: Or the image of the QR
invitations.imageHelp: A screenshot or a photo of the QR, received by a messaging app: its link fills the field above.
invitations.imageRead: The QR was read: its link is in the field.
invitations.myQRNeedsToken: Available once your token is enabled.
invitations.accountHelp: Rather than copying your token: an invitation, as a QR or a link, that the other server exchanges for it. Valid 12 hours, only once.
invitations.pendingHelp: Not used yet. Once exchanged, an invitation becomes a token of the list below; after 12 hours, it disappears.
invitations.pageHelp: This link is meant for a GameFlex server, not a browser. Opening it here uses nothing up.
invitations.pageServer: Open your own GameFlex, then Settings › Federations › Add a server, and paste this link — to see the games of this server.
invitations.pageAccount: Or, on the panel of one of its games, “Play at…” — when the invitation is for your account here.
invitations.pageValid: It is valid 12 hours, and only once.
